strings.mod.title: Moderation
strings.mod.signIn.title: Moderator sign-in
strings.mod.signIn.intro: Moderators only. Enter your moderator email and we'll send a sign-in link if it's on the list.
strings.mod.signIn.sent: If that address is on the moderator list, a sign-in link is on its way. Open it in this browser.
strings.mod.signIn.failed: That didn't go through. Try again in a few minutes.
strings.mod.forbidden: This account isn't on the moderator list.
strings.mod.unauthorized: Your session ended. Sign in again.
strings.mod.error: The queue didn't load. Try again.
strings.mod.queue.title: Open cases
strings.mod.queue.brigade: Possible brigade: many new or untrusted reporters
strings.mod.appeals.title: Pending appeals

strings.mod.action.title: Act on this case
strings.mod.action.note: Internal note (optional, never shown to the player)
strings.mod.action.abusive: These reports were abusive (counts against the reporters)
strings.mod.action.conflict: Someone already resolved this case. Reload the queue to see what changed.
strings.mod.action.idempotency: That action key was already used for something else. Reload and try again.
strings.mod.action.daysInvalid: Days must be a whole number from 1 to 365.
